reason: The legacy J1/J2 map does not match the common 30-pin DOIT DevKit V1. Confirm the exact physical module, correct the socket assignments and reroute before ordering.
required_before_release: Confirm both complete ESP32 header rows with USB at bottom and component side facing up.
Measure socket row spacing and check every module against a 1:1 board print.
Correct the socket map, routing and independent audit expectations.
Review supply delivery, display module supply requirements and shared MISO behaviour.
Run the pin audit and filled-zone DRC, then review the regenerated manufacturing previews.
